title: Smoove
description: Improves the Movement and Parkour Experience
body:
# Smoove (Shh-Move)

Smoove enhances Minecraft’s movement by introducing Source Engine style mechanics along with coyote time for smoother and more responsive control.
Perfect for parkour players and casual adventurers alike, Smoove makes movement feel faster, more fluid, and more forgiving.
